title: A Dashboard That Cannot Lie
tagline: Observability that lies is worse than none, and it will lie about itself first.

story.problem: A public engineering console reported four things that were not true, and none of them raised an error. It counted zero scouts during a five-way fan-out, because it was built on `subagent.called` — an event that eve 0.24.4 documents on the parent's durable stream and never emits. It displayed 73% for reply understanding, but that score belonged to a classifier that was reverted hours earlier. It counted every failed search as a healthy tool call, because `web_search` reports failure as `{status: "search_failed"}` and returns cleanly — no exception counter can see it. It also published 7/12, 58% for research quality beside a cookbook that cites 52/53 for the same command. The research eval graded a run whose scouts still searched: twelve checks, where a settled run produces thirty-seven to fifty-three. Every 'Open trace in LangSmith' button returned a 404 for one class of reason: the code built the link from the OTel trace id, not from the run id that LangSmith derives from a span id, and nothing fetched the run.
story.solution: Count delegations at `actions.requested`, where a subagent call is visible. Discover child lanes from the trace tree that each scout writes for itself. Move the success/refusal/failure taxonomy into agent/lib/actions.ts as one shared reading, in the order of eve's protocol — `status` before `error`, because eve attaches an error to a rejection and to a failure. Subtract refused calls through `toolRuns` before any surface reports work done. Stamp every eval summary with the model that it ran on. Refuse to score a run whose scouts never settled: `incomplete` carries the reason, and every surface renders that run as unscored. Verify that a LangSmith run exists before the URL is returned, and render `null` as a disabled caption, not as a dead link.
story.outcome: Lanes populate live, and the research eval stopped its triple run of one fan-out. `npm run test:outcomes` reads 22 status literals back out of 26 tool sources and fails on any literal that the taxonomy does not classify. `npm run test:fold` drives the real fold with events in eve's delivered shape. Two follow-up fixes each failed one level below the defect before that pair of tests existed. An unsettled research run now reads as unscored on `/observe` and prints NOT SCORED in `npm run report`. Thus the panel and the cookbook no longer quote different numbers for the same command. The structural fix for the stale score — a console flag on a summary whose model no longer matches the live routing — is recommended in the decision record and is not built.

prerequisites: KV_REST_API_URL and KV_REST_API_TOKEN (or the UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_* pair) — the trace store
LANGSMITH_API_KEY and LANGSMITH_TRACING=true — the exporter's export() is a no-op without the second
Node 24 (package.json `engines`) and `npm install` at the repository root
Recipe 02 (Delegation): a single-agent run has no tree, and the tree is where the lies live
One run that actually fans out — a panel with one lane cannot disagree with itself

quickstart.clone: git clone https://github.com/jaredwerba/vendor-scout.git && cd vendor-scout && npm install
quickstart.configure: Create .env.local with KV_REST_API_URL and KV_REST_API_TOKEN for the trace store, plus LANGSMITH_API_KEY and LANGSMITH_TRACING=true for span export. Neither guard command below needs them.
quickstart.run: npm run test:outcomes && npm run test:fold

endpoints.description: Every root session, newest first — the session picker on /observe. Summaries are redacted at write time, so the route needs no gate.
One whole agent tree: the root plus every specialist, each with its recorded event log, plus a LangSmith URL that is null unless the run was verified to exist.
Every eval summary the scripts have uploaded, each stamped with the model it ran on.
